blocks.content: In this lesson, we will explore some commonly used form attributes that enhance the functionality of our forms.

rows: Displays a hint on what to enter inside the input field or text area
Sets the initial value for a field.
Specifies a field that must be filled before submitting the form.
Prevents the user from interacting with the field.
